claims: The Valspar Championship is played at the Innisbrook Resort and Golf Club in Palm Harbor, Florida.
The Innisbrook Resort and Golf Club is located near Tampa and Clearwater.
The Valspar Championship is held annually on the Copperhead Course.
The Copperhead Course has pine-lined fairways.
The Copperhead Course has the "Snake Pit" finishing holes.
Innisbrook Resort (Copperhead Course) is located at 36750 U.S. Highway 19 North, Palm Harbor, FL.
The Copperhead Course is ranked among the hardest on the PGA TOUR.
The Copperhead Course features significant elevation changes.
The final three holes (16, 17, and 18) are known as the "Snake Pit".
